description:
Makes the CPU LDPC stage of `gf2-sim` decode through the generic batch decode stage with the LDPC batch decoder, in place of a per-frame loop over a mutex-guarded single-frame decoder.

## Background

The batch soft-decoder trait of `gf2-coding` decodes a batch of LLR frames into caller-provided decoded words and per-frame outcomes in input order. Its LDPC implementer, the LDPC batch decoder, decodes fixed waves of eight lanes with per-frame termination, routes a wave to the lane kernels or to the single-frame decoder by the decode selectors of the coding tuning section, and returns each frame's result equal to the single-frame decoder's bit for bit as `docs/reference/ldpc-decoder-numerical-contract.md` states. A `gf2-sim` stage processes a batch by shared reference with a default-constructed mutable scratch. The generic batch decode stage of `gf2-sim` holds a factory of a `gf2-coding` batch soft decoder, builds the decoder once in its scratch, and decodes an `LlrBatch` into a `HardDecisionBatch` with the per-frame iteration counts recorded in the scratch. The stage `CpuLdpcBp` is the CPU fallback of the GPU LDPC stage; its `process` locks one `LdpcDecoder` and decodes the frames of an `LlrBatch` one at a time into codewords.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `CpuLdpcBp` decodes its batch through the generic batch decode stage with an LDPC batch decoder that returns full codewords, and holds no per-frame loop and no decoder mutex.
- [hard] REQ-02: Its output equals the per-frame `decode_to_codeword` output for an empty batch, one frame and batches with an incomplete final wave.
- [hard] REQ-03: The GPU byte-identity and CPU-fallback suites that use the stage pass unchanged.
title: Decode CPU LDPC stage batches through the batch decode stage
